examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Single-select with four flat options at large size.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: All three trigger sizes side by side, sharing one bound value.

examples.name: Transparent
examples.summary: `kind="transparent"`: no border or fill until hover, sized to its value and set like a breadcrumb crumb. The environment switcher that ends a resource's breadcrumb; the panel keeps a readable minimum width instead of the trigger's.

examples.name: Single
examples.summary: Single-select mode, the default: each option shows a radio-style indicator, choosing one closes the panel, and `modelValue` is one value. Pair it with Multiple to compare the two modes.

examples.name: Multiple
examples.summary: Multi-select mode: options toggle on click and `modelValue` is an array.

examples.name: WithGroups
examples.summary: `<Select.Group label="…">` renders an uppercase heading above each set of options.

examples.name: WithSearchAndFooter
examples.summary: The `#search` and `#footer` slots on `<Select.Content>` host a filter input and a "Create new" action; the option list scrolls between them.

examples.name: WithOptionExtras
examples.summary: Per-option affordances on `<Select.Option>`: the `icon` prop, the `#left` slot, and the trailing `#tag` slot.

examples.name: LongList
examples.summary: A long option list; the panel caps its height and scrolls internally.

examples.name: Filled
examples.summary: Pre-selected value shows the filled trigger treatment.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid state (danger border + ring); it clears once a value is selected.

examples.name: Required
examples.summary: Required state (warning border + `aria-required`). It is a submit state: bind `required` to `submitted && !value` so the field is flagged only after a submit attempt and clears once a value is selected. Press Submit with nothing selected to see it.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled trigger; the dropdown cannot open.
